manufacturer_reference.title: LS2208 Product Reference Guide
manufacturer_reference.scope: LS2208 model family; exact unit generation and interface cable not yet verified

manufacturer_facts: LS2208 product guide describes a modular replaceable scanner-to-host interface cable.
Different host/interface modes are supported, including USB and RS-232; a given cable cannot be assumed interchangeable.
USB host modes include USB HID keyboard; RS-232 implementations depend on suitable host cable and configuration.

hypotheses.statement: A cut or damaged interface cable may interrupt power and/or host data.
discriminating_evidence: Photographs of exact specimen, physical cable damage, connector, and strain relief
Exact scanner and cable part numbers plus manufacturer-compatible replacement interface
Qualified operator unpowered cable continuity/short inspection

hypotheses.statement: Host/cable/interface variation may prevent recognition or correct communication.
discriminating_evidence: Exact host-cable model/part number and host interface mode
Manufacturer manual matching the identified variant
Observed connection behavior following a separately authorized safe test

hypotheses.statement: Internal electronics or optics may be faulty independently of cable condition.
discriminating_evidence: Physical enclosure/PCB condition and exact assembly identification
Baseline optical/host behavior observed by a qualified operator with validated cable and safe setup
Further fault isolation if a verified cable does not restore scanning

hypotheses.statement: Configuration or decode settings may prevent a compatible host from receiving a scan.
discriminating_evidence: Record exact host operating mode and USB HID or RS-232 expectations
Manufacturer troubleshooting guide and model-specific configuration procedure
Observed decoded scan output in a supervised post-repair test
